source.name: Prastara
source.note: Prastara's own recipes: the Mula series and the media models Prastara runs

recipes.name: mula-setu-v0.1
recipes.description: Mula Setu (सेतु): tool calls and MCP, picking the tool and exact arguments. Base: Qwen3-8B looped with Avarta (am2strata-workshop loop), Orca teaching; set --model to the looped folder.
recipes.yaml:
base: Qwen/Qwen3-8B
task: sft

data:
  train: ./data/mula-setu.jsonl
  format: auto
  max_length: 4096
  train_on_responses_only: true

training:
  epochs: 2
  lr: 1e-4
  lora:
    r: 16
    alpha: 32
    target_modules: auto
  quantization: none

output: ./output/mula-setu-v0.1
recipes.serves: Prastara's chat, agent and API (as GGUF or Kosha)

task: sft
modality: vision

  train: ./data/train.jsonl
  format: llava
  image_dir: ./data/image

training:
  epochs: 3
  lr: 5e-5
  lora:
    r: 16
    alpha: 32
    target_modules: auto
  quantization: none

output: ./output/mula-drishti-v0.1
